g.text: Effects run after the coil stops in BOTH launch modes. With launch enabled, release follows the fixed candy-settling delay.
After release: wind to latch, then fully unwind for slack. All motion uses timing; no physical confirmation.
ID used: after release when launch is enabled; after the coil stops when disabled. STOP inhibits every output except LCDs.
* Second TFT content and audio storage remain TBD. Preferred SD music path is not yet specified. Startup cocking remains TBD; reset is a Master Mode menu action.
